week.headline: The NFELO model and Vegas are 17.6 percentage points apart on Philadelphia at Washington.

rest.headline: San Francisco and Minnesota share the top projection, 12.8 wins.
rest.note: Projected wins = wins so far + half a win per tie + the sum of the team's win probabilities in its remaining games.

playoff_odds.headline: Baltimore's playoff chances rose the most this week, to 45%. San Francisco is the Super Bowl favorite at 12%.
